text:
marco_sales: Vectorix POC hit a spike of 429s during a nightly batch + live chat demo overlap. Demo later today. Need quick ops triage @anya_se @derek_eng

anya_se: Can you paste the client error and say how they run the batch (cron, workers, batch_size)?

marco_sales: client log snippet: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 75
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 9
{"error":{"message":"rate limit exceeded","code":429}}
```
They run a nightly cron that spins 60 workers for embeddings (batch=200) and also have a small live chat demo hitting chat completions concurrently.

derek_eng: That matches per-route cap on embeddings=75 r/s for their tenant. If the cron starts all workers at once it will exhaust bucket quickly. Also chat concurrency adds token pressure.

hana_infra: Hosted shared pool so autoscaler won't give them dedicated capacity. Short-term options: 1) TTLed soft bump to 150 r/s for embeddings route, 2) enable route queueing to cap inflight requests and smooth ramp, 3) suggest client staggers cron start and reduces batch to 64.

omar_sre: Queueing + client stagger is safest. Bump ok for a narrow window but requires ops approval. We can also enable short-lived increased token-window for imports to absorb the ramp.

marco_sales: Sales ok to try queueing + guidance first. If still failing, we'll request a 3h bump.

ivy_support: I'll send the client a tiny import runner diff that ramps workers over 2 minutes and adds jittered backoff on 429. Snippet: 
```python
for i in range(60):
    start_worker(delay=i*2)  # stagger start by 2s

# retry on 429 with jitter
if resp.status_code == 429:
    sleep((2 ** attempt) + random.random())
```

anya_se: I'll add a presales preflight item: flag cron imports that would start >30 concurrent workers or estimate token/sec > 80k. If flagged, require ops preflight.

hana_infra: I'll enable per-route queueing for tenant VEC-11 (max_inflight=30) now with a 4h TTL so sales can run the demo. Deploying.

omar_sre: deploy_bot: "apply config cfg_vec_11_queue by hana_infra"

omar_sre: deploy_bot: "config applied (cfg_vec_11_queue)"

derek_eng: Monitoring shows X-RateLimit-Remaining no longer dropping to zero on ramp. A couple of 429s when they manually restarted the cron; backoff handled them.

marco_sales: Customer reran and demo users report smooth performance. Leaving action items: anya_se add preflight check; ivy_support send import patch + best practices; hana_infra keep TTLed queueing until EOD and report metrics. Thanks team :tada:
